newsitem.title: USA: ITT says board meeting over on Hilton bid.
newsitem.headline: ITT says board meeting over on Hilton bid.

text.p: ITT Corp said a meeting of its board of directors has ended without action taken on a $6.5 billion offer launched last week by Hilton Hotels Corp.
Spokesman Jim Gallagher said the board has not set another meeting to discuss the Hilton bid. He declined to comment on the length of the board meeting or the board's reaction to the Hilton offer.
"We have no public comment about the specifics of the meeting at all," he said.

Gallagher also reiterated the ITT board has 10 business days to respond to Hilton's offer, which was officially launched on Friday. Under that deadline, ITT must respond to the offer by February 14. The Tuesday meeting had been a regularly-scheduled session of the ITT board.

Hilton's cash and stock offer values ITT at $55 per share. Hilton has also proposed acquiring about $4 billion of ITT debt. Shares of ITT, which have risen sharply since Hilton announced its intent to launch a tender offer, dipped 1/8 to 56-3/4 on Tuesday.
